meaning: Exact lower-bound decoded RGBA equivalents for actual metadata dimensions and current launch asset selection. This is not measured browser/process/VRAM peak; metadata, decoded/compositor copies, floor/canvas, texture drivers and other UI are extra.
maskPolicy: Every current hero active frame has a baked bodyIdentificationContour. loadBodyAlpha resolves true with no Image allocation; new boss masks are not included in plan.maskIds.
recommendations: Keep existing compact static IDs in bossPortraits and bossDetailPortraits. Bind new motion IDs only under bosses; never alias 512-frame game atlases to the whole codex.
Existing per-mission gate and commit-time eviction are already conservative about preserving a still-playable old scene on failure. Do not evict old active assets before successful replacement.

For two animated bosses per mission, 256-cell16direction32sample atlases add256MiB decoded_RGBA per mission. Prefer64MiB8direction or32MiB128-cell actual native bakes if target mobile memory cannot support the measured outcome.
No extra body-alpha PNG decode is needed for bosses. Preserve original masks on disk for provenance; omit them from preload.
Do not equate compressed PNG/GLB file size or atlas maximum32MP with32MiB. One32MP_RGBA image is128MiB.
